name: @deterministic-code/migraters
description: Migrate executables for deterministic-code (typescript, rust, csharp).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p orchestrator/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --prefix typescript
scripts.test: npm run prepare && npm run test:orchestrator && npm run test --prefix typescript && npm run test:rust && npm run test:csharp
scripts.test:rust: node orchestrator/dist/migrate-init.js --language rust --all && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=rust/target cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --lib --fail-under-lines 100 --fail-under-functions 100 --fail-under-regions 100 --ignore-filename-regex 'src/(abstractions|argv|checksum|cli_spec|help|infrastructure|messages|migrater|migrations|provider)|lib\.rs'
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f proof/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres mysql sqlserver oracle && rm -rf sql && cp -R proof/sql sql && npm run e2e:typescript && npm run e2e:rust && npm run e2e:csharp
